payout_quote: Open a new Perks+ Checking account by September 30, 2026 and earn a $275 welcome bonus, plus we will waive your first $6.95 monthly service charge.
steps: Qualify for Georgia's Own Credit Union membership; open a new Perks+ Checking account online by September 30, 2026 using promo code BONUS275 on the account funding page (required to activate the bonus)

In each of the first two consecutive monthly statement cycles: make 15 qualifying debit card purchases of $5+ each AND receive qualifying direct deposit(s) totaling $1,500+ per cycle (DD must be established within 30 days of opening; payroll/pension/government ACH only - P2P and Georgia's Own transfers excluded)
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $275 bonus is deposited within 120 days of promotion enrollment
catches: Tight deadline: offer valid August 1 - September 30, 2026
Promo code BONUS275 must be entered on the account funding page at opening - missing it disqualifies you
Perks+ Checking carries a $6.95 monthly service charge; only the first month is waived, so you may pay ~$14-35 in fees before the bonus posts (up to 120 days after enrollment)
15 debit purchases of $5+ EACH and $1,500+ direct deposit EACH in two consecutive statement cycles - heavier activity requirement than many bonuses
Only payroll, pension, or government ACH qualifies as direct deposit; P2P (PayPal, Zelle, Venmo) and Georgia's Own account transfers excluded
Not available to existing Georgia's Own checking holders or accounts closed within 90 days / closed with negative balance within 3 years
Cannot combine with any other checking offer; business, employee, second, and multiple checking accounts excluded
Bonus is taxable income reported to the IRS
biggest_catch: Two consecutive months of 15 debit purchases ($5+ each) plus $1,500+ payroll direct deposit each month, a $6.95 monthly account fee (first month waived), and up to 120 days to receive the bonus - and the offer closes September 30, 2026.
eligibility: New Georgia's Own CU checking members; not existing checking holders and not closed within 90 days or closed negative within 3 years; consumer accounts only.
timing: Open by 9/30/2026; qualify over two consecutive statement cycles; bonus deposited within 120 days of promotion enrollment.
